Simulate adaptive tests

Source: R/cat.R
cat_simulate.Rd

Runs a Monte Carlo (or post-hoc) simulation of a CAT design. Simulees either have known true trait values, from which responses are generated with the bank's item parameters, or bring a complete matrix of real responses (post-hoc simulation) from which the adaptive test reads the answers.

Usage

cat_simulate(
  design,
  theta = NULL,
  responses = NULL,
  seed = NULL,
  progress = FALSE
)

Arguments

design

A cat_design().

theta

True trait values (Monte Carlo simulation).

responses

Optional matrix of responses with one column per bank item (post-hoc simulation). Overrides theta.

seed

Optional random seed.

progress

Print progress.

Value

An object of class cat_sim with per-person results (results), the full administration history (history), item exposure rates (exposure) and the design.

Examples

bank <- make_bank(b = rnorm(150), a = rlnorm(150, 0, 0.3), model = "2pl")
design <- cat_design(bank, max_items = 25, se_target = 0.3, exposure = "randomesque")
sim <- cat_simulate(design, theta = rnorm(200), seed = 1)
summary(sim)
#> CAT simulation: 200 simulees
#>   test length: mean 21.9 (SD 2.4), range 19-25
#>   stopping reasons: max_items 61, se_target 139 
#>   mean final SE: 0.306
#>   recovery: bias -0.003, RMSE 0.302, r = 0.945
#>   exposure: max 0.910, 50.7% of bank unused, test overlap 0.562, chi-square 62.7
